protocol.modalities: WA RGB+initial BBox+ideal simulated polar UWB no text; LightNav RGB+text; different inputs
protocol.same_physics: same benchmark configuration required by frozen job source; initial RGB equality is not proof of identical future trajectories
protocol.scope: 24 episodes across 8 scenes repeated in STT/DT/AT, not 24 independent scenes; one seed; no tuning after reading confirmation
protocol.collision_metric: reported benchmark collision flag, not independently instrumented static-wall or rear-doorframe contact rate
protocol.limits: small independent confirmation set, no statistical superiority/product SR90/real-UWB/edge-latency claim; preserved architecture and checkpoint
